title: Switchback Price Experiments with Forward-Looking Demand
abstract: arXiv:2410.14904v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Switchback experiments are widely used in pricing applications. We consider a retailer running such an experiment for the price of a single product, with infinite supply. In each period, the seller chooses a price from a set of predefined prices consisting of an original price and a few discounted price levels. The goal is to estimate the demand gradient at the original price to adjust the original price and improve revenue after the experiment. In our model, in each period, a unit mass of buyers arrives on the market, with values distributed based on a time-varying process. Crucially, buyers are forward-looking with a discounted utility and will choose not to purchase now if they expect to face a discounted price in the near future. translated_title: 面向前瞻性需求的切换式价格实验
translated_abstract: 切换式实验被广泛应用于定价场景。我们考虑一家零售商针对供应无限的单个产品开展此类价格实验。在每个周期，卖家从一组预先定义的价格中进行选择，这组价格由原价和若干折扣价位构成。实验的目标是估计原价处的需求梯度，以便在实验结束后调整原价并提升收入。在我们的模型中，每个周期都有单位质量的买家进入市场，其估值由一个随时间变化的过程决定。关键在于，买家是前瞻性的且效用具有时间折现，如果他们预期近期将出现折扣价，就会选择暂不购买。我们证明，这种前瞻性行为会由于跨期干扰而使需求梯度的朴素估计量产生偏差。此外，尽管仅有两个价格点的实验……
tldr: 该论文研究了买家具有前瞻性行为（预期降价而策略性延迟购买）时的切换式定价实验，证明跨期干扰会使原价处需求梯度的朴素估计量产生偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper studies switchback price experiments with forward-looking buyers who strategically delay purchases when expecting future discounts, showing that such intertemporal interference biases naive estimators of the demand gradient at the original price.
